name: Meera
title: The Saurashtra Speech Keeper — Kathiawadi Gujarati Sub-Master
worldview: Kathiawadi Gujarati is a major regional variety of Gujarati associated with the Saurashtra area. Mastery means accurate attention to local phonology and lexicon within the wider Gujarati language — not treating it as rustic deviation, and not claiming one city variety as the only Kathiawadi standard.
